programs.title: Aloha, new home
programs.desc: Spouses Kamohai and Tristyn Kalama are native Hawaiians whose passion and mission is to renovate abandoned houses on the island of Oahu.Contrary to appearances, it is not just pleasant work in beautiful natural surroundings.Many of these properties are in a deplorable condition due to moisture, wind and sun.Renovations are additionally complicated by difficult terrain and changeable weather.However, the reward for designers is the end result, which is worth every moment spent renovating these amazing buildings.

programs.title: Man v Food 2
programs.desc: Adam sets off on a journey across the United States to take part in subsequent rounds of timed eating competitions.Adam will take on Badass Burrito in Las Vegas and a 106-centimetre pizza in San Antonio.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: Łukasz and Piotr had been looking for a house to buy for almost two years.Finally, the building of the old school in Kwieciszowice, near Jelenia Góra, stole their hearts.Patryk, who lived in Tricity for many years, finally settled in Borzęcin, near Słupsk.He was also enchanted by the building of the former German school.Anna and Paweł came across a ruined school during a bicycle trip around Masuria Garbate.They immediately knew that this place had huge potential.The building's appearance today is confirmation of this.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska visits unusual houses, located in charming natural surroundings.The host will watch, among others:Dutch houses, barges, trailers, and houses made of containers.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: There is an energy-saving house by Justyna and Piotr in Smolniki, Greater Poland.The building, located in the middle of the forest, has direct access to the lake and is equipped with solar panels that give the owners independence.Joanna and Artur, parents of three children, moved into the house from a two-room apartment.Their priority was low electricity bills.Thanks to the use of modern solutions, life for a family of five does not generate high costs.Marcin, a sailing enthusiast, built a floating house that is moored on Lake Charzykowskie.The nature surrounding the building influenced the energy-saving solutions used in it.
